generations.prompt: Early evening on a timber porch. In the foreground, seen from behind and out of focus, an old woman with silver hair sits in a wooden armchair. Beyond her, at the foot of the porch steps, stands her granddaughter of twenty with a bag on her shoulder, having just arrived unannounced. The young woman takes a breath and says, shyly and a little clumsily, in her grandmother's language: "Suvé, ilo." (soo-véh, ee-lóh). The old woman goes completely still, her back to the camera; she does not speak. The young woman waits, smiling nervously, shifting her weight. Then the old woman slowly begins to turn her head toward her. Sound: the young woman's voice, wind in tall grass, evening insects. The camera is locked off and does not move. No music. No subtitles, captions or on-screen text of any kind.
